text: In 2021, the asset experienced tree-cover loss of approximately 81.3 hectares (2.23% of the total area), primarily in planted forests (Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda). The loss was detected by the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset and corroborated by the JRC 2020 forest reference map (98% agreement). While the change was confirmed as tree-cover loss, it does not specify whether it was deforestation, the cause (e.g., harvest, fire), legality, or responsible actors. Additional small patches (<0.5 ha) totaling 37.3 ha were also lost but not counted as events. The assessment is supported by multi-source evidence but does not establish persistence or compliance status.
